remit.title: Remit Payment Details
remit.intro: You can send payment to M-Pesa via the ADIB app using Remit!
remit.step1: Open ADIB App and go to "Transfers"
remit.step3: Choose Kenya and enter the details below

remitly.title: Remitly / WorldRemit / Sendwave (for US clients)
remitly.intro: For US clients: Use Remitly, WorldRemit, or Sendwave to send payment. Use the same recipient details as below. You can pay via mobile banking / M-Pesa, bank transfer, or cash at supported locations.
remitly.opt1Step1: Open Remitly, WorldRemit, or Sendwave app
remitly.opt1Step2: Select send to Kenya, choose M-Pesa
remitly.opt2Intro: For bank transfer, use these Equity Bank details:
remitly.cashNote: Cash: Cash pickup is available at supported Remitly/WorldRemit/Sendwave locations. Please retain your receipt and share the reference with us.

emoney.title: E&money Payment Details
emoney.intro: Use the e& money app to send funds. You can link your ADIB card easily.
emoney.step1: In e& money, tap "Add Money" using your ADIB card
emoney.step3: Select Kenya and enter the details below

alansari.title: Al Ansari, Lulu, or Al Fardan Exchange Payment Details
alansari.intro: At Al Ansari, Lulu, or Al Fardan exchange, you can pay via mobile banking / M-Pesa, bank transfer, or cash. All options are acceptable.
alansari.opt1Step1: Visit an Al Ansari, Lulu, or Al Fardan branch
alansari.opt2Intro: For bank transfer at the exchange, use these Equity Bank details:
alansari.cashNote: Cash: Cash payment is also acceptable at the counter. Please retain your receipt and share the reference with us.

bank.title: Direct Bank Transfer Details
bank.intro: Use one of the options below. Do not mix details. Use the exact details for your chosen option to avoid processing delays.
